provisionalClassification: possible React ViewTransition contract/implementation mismatch; not yet supported as a code bug
provisionalDirection: Verify the exact public enter-prop contract and the release-version portal traversal before proposing a code edit. Current source explicitly limits a newly mounted subtree to its first ViewTransition, so a portal-specific change must not be assumed safe.

observations.excerpt: The reporter says an inner portal-mounted <ViewTransition> receives neither a name nor class in React 19.3.0; no comments or maintainer disposition are present.
commitEnterViewTransitions applies a name/class when its placement is a ViewTransition; otherwise it recursively visits children only when ViewTransitionStatic is present.
Current source states: 'The first ViewTransition inside a newly mounted tree runs an enter transition but other nested ones don't unless they have a named pair.'

hypotheses.claim: The documented enter contract requires the nested portal boundary to receive its own enter name/class, and the first-only traversal is a bug.
hypotheses.necessaryAssumption: The quoted documentation applies to nested ViewTransition boundaries, not merely a parent component's own mount semantics.
hypotheses.weakeningObservation: An authoritative prop document/test states nested entries are intentionally suppressed.

hypotheses.claim: The behavior is intentional first-boundary semantics; the report misreads or exposes ambiguous documentation, so no reconciler edit is safe.
